docs.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Benchmarks for Conversational Agents
docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-08-06 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.06329v1

docs.title: 具身智能

  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.SE · arXiv:2607.21530v1

docs.text:
• 作者：Linjun Li
  • 提交：2026-07-23 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2607.21518v1

docs.text:

Loggia dei Lanzi: AI Thermography Enhancement Comparisons through 3D Photogrammetry
docs.text:
• 作者：Scott McAvoy, Jonathan Klingspon, George Bent, Dave Pfaff, Aviral Agarwal 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.02404v1

The Loggia dei Lanzi in the Piazza della Signoria is one of Florence's most prominent structures visited by millions every year. Its construction history spans multiple centuries of modification.

docs.title: USP-Mamba: Unmixing-Derived Spectral and Structural Prompting for Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
docs.text:
• 作者：Shi Chen, Jie Zhang, Yicong Zhou
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.02401v1

Hyperspectral image super-resolution aims to reconstruct high-resolution imagery while preserving dense spectral information. Recently, Mamba-based models have shown promising potential for this task by capturing long-range dependencies with linear computational complexity.

docs.title: SpikeRestormer: Towards Energy-Efficient All-in-One Image Restoration via Unified Event Reasoning
docs.text:
• 作者：Shengkai Hu, Jie Shao, Jiaqi Ma, Xu Zhang, Keying Wu 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.02290v1

ANN-based All-in-One image restoration (AiOIR) unifies diverse degradation handling but incurs high computational costs, limiting its real-time deployment. While Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a low-power alternative, applying them to static images remains challenging.

docs.title: CLEAR: Conflict-aware Learning via Evidence-guided Adaptive Routing for Unified Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Super-Resolution
docs.text:

  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.02206v1

Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting Super-resolution is highly challenging since the sparse and low-resolution (LR) inputs lack sufficient geometric and high-frequency information for accurate reconstruction.

docs.title: DerainSplat: Feed-Forward Clean 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Rainy Views
docs.text:
• 作者：Fuzhen Jiang, Changyue Shi, Chuxiao Yang, Xinyuan Hu, Wenjie Ye 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.02191v1

Although image deraining has advanced substantially, existing methods mainly focus on 2D image restoration. As spatial intelligence applications such as embodied AI and autonomous driving continue to emerge, reconstructing clean 3D scenes from sparse rainy views in a feed-forward manner becomes increasingly important.

docs.title: Beyond Illumination: A Conditional Mutual Information-Guided Network for Low-Light Image Enhancement
docs.text:
• 作者：Ya-nan Guan, Shaonan Zhang, Tao Dai, Tianqu Zhuang, Yongchao Qiao 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.01886v1

Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) seeks to restore structural fidelity, natural color rendition, and proper exposure from images captured under inadequate lighting conditions.

docs.title: Detail Continuation over a Trustworthy Coarse Scale for Autoregressive Super-Resolution
docs.text:
• 作者：Hongyi Fang, Jiahui Wu, Yichen Yue, Benjia Zhou, Dan Zeng
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.01823v1

Hallucination remains a persistent challenge in generative super-resolution (GSR), where reconstructed results may contain visually plausible yet weakly supported content, structural deviations, or unnatural textures with respect to the low-resolution (LR) input.

docs.title: Pixel Ignores, Superpixel Sees: Adverse Weather Image Restoration via Semantic-Center SSM
docs.text:
• 作者：Dayu Li, Shihao Zhou, Leizhi Shu, Jin Wu, Chi Man Vong 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.01760v1

Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover clear visibility from degraded images in complex weather conditions. Existing works attempt to address this problem by modeling relationships between pixels, however, this paradigm defies the spatially non-uniformity fact of degradations and learns non-discriminative fe…

docs.title: When Extreme Darkness Meets Motion Blur: MeanFlow for Unified RAW Restoration
docs.text:
• 作者：Zepu Wang, Jingze Liang, Weijie Xiao, Kexin Chen
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.01720v1

Extremely low-light RAW enhancement aims to recover severely attenuated sensor signals, yet existing methods often focus on illumination and noise while overlooking the motion-induced degradations inherent in practical low-light imaging.

docs.title: FAU at ImageCLEF 2026 Task on Multimodal Reasoning Robust Candidate Scoring and Concise Multilingual Visual Answering
docs.text:
• 作者：Mohamed Basem, Vincent Christlein
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.01664v1

We present our ImageCLEF 2026 Multimodal Reasoning system for the Visual Multiple Choice Question Answering (Visual MCQ) and Visual Open Question Answering (Visual OpenQA) subtasks.

docs.title: 大语言模型
Bridging Artificial Intelligence and Power Systems Education Using a Hands-On Executable Framework
docs.text:
• 作者：Junjie Yin, Buxin She, Xinyu Feng, Fangxing, Li
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 eess.SY · arXiv:2608.02599v1

Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly central to power and energy systems, supporting modeling, forecasting, optimization, and control. Yet most existing works emphasize specialized applications and offer little reusable material for newcomers or interdisciplinary learners, who increasingly rely on large languag…

docs.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning
docs.text:
• 作者：Zhaoxin Yu, Qi Shen, Hengli Li, Zhaowei Zhang, Song-Chun Zhu 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2608.02585v1

Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen.

docs.title: UEmbed: Unified Sparse and Dense Multimodal Embeddings
docs.text:
• 作者：Tingyu Song, Mingxin Li, Yanzhao Zhang, Dingkun Long, Pengjun Xie 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.02583v1

Sparse retrieval underpins modern search systems, from web search to retrieval-augmented generation. Existing work has introduced Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) to push beyond exact lexical matching toward richer semantics.

docs.title: AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies
docs.text:
• 作者：Qiushi Lin, Chaojie Zhang, Íñigo Goiri, Aditya Akella, Ricardo Bianchini 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.02569v1

The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent, and prototyping a single policy takes months. Agentic AI promises to automate this search.

docs.title: Structured Memory for Edge Language Models: Persistent Context and Corpus Retrieval via O(1) SSM State Injection
docs.text:
• 作者：Anusha Madan Gopal, Aras Pirbadian, Kristofor D. Carlson, M Anthony Lewis, Jonathan Tapson
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2608.02560v1

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) imposes a prefill cost proportional to retrieved context length, and -- with Transformer backbones -- a KV-cache that grows with each generated token.

docs.title: MedPRESS: A Multi-turn Benchmark for Patient-Pressure-Induced Medical Sycophancy in LLMs
docs.text:
• 作者：Saman Sarker Joy, Niloy Farhan
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.02520v1

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for health-related advice. Existing research measures their safety with static questions rather than pressured patient-facing conversations. We introduce MedPRESS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring patient-pressure-induced sycophancy in LLMs.

docs.title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
docs.text:
• 作者：Zhichen Liu, Ruihan Sun, Hengjie Yang, Zipeng Wu, Zhaohan Chen 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.02515v1

Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes.

docs.title: RoMeRL: Balancing Feedback Coverage and the Memory-Reward Trap in Self-Evolving Agent Memory via Reduced-Order Utility States
docs.text:
• 作者：Yi Yang, Zhennan Chen, Yihong Zhuang, Tiehan Fan, Yinan Chen 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.LG · arXiv:2608.02508v1

Learning-based memory systems for self-evolving LLM agents face two tightly coupled challenges. First, trajectory-indexed utilities grow with the interaction history, thereby dispersing limited feedback over an ever-expanding state space.

docs.title: Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs
docs.text:
• 作者：Iaroslav Chelombitko, Ekaterina Chelombitko, Mika Hämäläinen
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.02486v1

Open-source LLMs reliably name Zeus, Jupiter, and Thor, but recover their counterparts in less-represented traditions like Finnish, Slavic, Egyptian, or Chinese mythology far less consistently. We ask where inside the model this cultural default is produced.

docs.title: CTRAG: An In-Context Retrieval-based Framework for Automated Compliance Checking using LLMs
docs.text:
• 作者：Muhammad Roman, Karen Rafferty, Barry Devereux
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.02472v1

Trust is fundamental in modern regulatory ecosystems, and compliance checking plays a critical role in fostering that trust. Regulatory compliance verification is essential for businesses operating in highly controlled environments, as it ensures alignment with sector-specific guidelines across domains such as financia…

docs.title: Real-Time Detection and Repair of LLM Agent Failures
docs.text:
• 作者：Sunny Dubey
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.02464v1

LLM agents fail mid-episode -- they loop, cascade tool errors, drift off goal, fabricate results, or silently absorb corrupted content -- and the standard remedy, judging every step with a second LLM, costs more than the agent itself.

docs.title: ParEvalLayer: When Partial LLM-Agent Evaluations Support a Decision
docs.text:
• 作者：Wei-Jung Huang, Bonan Shen
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.02444v1

LLM-agent evaluations often produce task outcomes long before the full benchmark run is complete. A partial score is tempting to report, but it does not show whether the observed tasks support the same conclusion as the completed evaluation.

docs.title: 具身智能
Ego2Robot: Scalable Robot Data Synthesis from Egocentric Human Data
docs.text:
• 作者：Ye Wang, Pei Lin, Xiong-Hui Chen, Haoqi Yuan, Zhixuan Liang 等 15 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.02580v1

Learning generalizable robot manipulation policies requires large-scale and diverse demonstration data. Egocentric human manipulation videos offer rich scene and task diversity, and prior work has shown that retargeting and rendering such videos into robot-format data can yield effective per-task policies at small scal…

docs.title: Abduction Without a Body? Representational Grounding and the Abduction Loop for Scientific Hypothesis Generation
docs.text:
• 作者：Michael Farmer
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.02505v1

Can scientific abduction occur without continuous sensorimotor embodiment? Recent arguments in AI and philosophy of science hold that genuine hypothesis generation requires an agent continuously coupled to the physical world.

docs.title: Grounded Semantic Re-Binding for Robust Instruction Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Zhaokai Yin, Zhipeng Zhang
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.02497v1

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in robotic manipulation but suffer catastrophic performance drops when canonical instructions are simply paraphrased. Although this brittleness is typically addressed through costly data scaling, our probing reveals that the root cause is architectural rather than a lack of sem…

docs.title: Faster-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Deep Action Modules?
docs.text:
• 作者：Liheng Ma, Rui Heng Yang, Zhanguang Zhang, Mateo Clemente, Ziwen Hu 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.AI · arXiv:2608.02365v1

World Action Models (WAMs) couple robot action prediction with video world models. Existing WAMs with shared-backbone and Mixture-of-Transformers designs generally tie the depth of the action module to that of the video backbone, resulting in substantial computational overhead and high inference latency.

docs.title: ChainVLA: Chaining Vision-Language-Action Queries through a Unified Execution State for Long-Horizon Manipulation
docs.text:
• 作者：Yuzhi Huang, Weijue Bu, Ziyi Xiong, Jie Wu, Fanding Huang 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.02326v1

Humans perform long-horizon manipulation by retaining knowledge of what earlier actions have established while continuously adapting the motion underway. By contrast, action-chunked vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly replan from the current input at each query.

docs.title: Learning Panorama-Aware VLA for Mobile Manipulation with Whole-Body Teleoperation
docs.text:
• 作者：Donglin Yang, Haoran Chen, Xingyu Chen, Lixing Liu, Manyi Li 等 9 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.02257v1

Mobile manipulation is a key capability for embodied intelligence, enabling robots to accomplish complex multi-stage tasks in open-world environments. However, mobile manipulation poses two key challenges for vision-language-action (VLA) policies: At the data level, the efficient collection of high-quality whole-body d…

docs.title: Look Where It Matters: Adaptive Visual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Jin Cui, Yanbin Hu, Xinyue Long, Linkai Li, Boran Zhao 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.02197v1

Visual representations of VLA models remain unreliable for spatially precise robotic manipulation. We uncover that vision encoders in VLAs also exhibit attention artifacts previously documented in generic Vision Transformers, and further show that, in embodied policies, these artifacts are closely associated with spati…

docs.title: PhyCheck: Fine-Grained Evidence-Grounded Dataset for Physical Law Understanding in Video-LLMs
docs.text:
• 作者：Zhongjie Ba, Shengwang Xu, Peng Cheng, Jinyang Zou, Ting Yu 等 7 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.02150v1

Embodied intelligence and world models require video understanding systems to go beyond recognizing objects and actions and develop an understanding of physical regularities.

docs.title: MANGO-Grasp: Mahalanobis Fields over Geometry-Oriented 3D Gaussians for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping
docs.text:
• 作者：Heng Zhang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Mike Zheng Shou, Weisi Lin, Yan Wu
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.02014v1

Cross-embodiment dexterous grasping aims to synthesize stable grasps across heterogeneous multi-fingered hands with little or no embodiment-specific tuning. Existing interaction-centric methods achieve promising results, but their object representations often underrepresent local surface geometry, while their robot des…

docs.title: SpatioLM: Towards General Physical Spatial Intelligence in Vision-Language Models
docs.text:
• 作者：Jing Wu, Jianhua Wu, Jiayi Guan, Jiahong Chen, Jinghui Lu 等 8 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.CV · arXiv:2608.01899v1

Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on commonsense reasoning tasks but struggle with visual spatial reasoning. Most existing solutions introduce extra 3D prior inputs or external spatial encoders, which increase complexity and degrade the underlying VLMs' general-purpose capabilities after spatial fine-tuning.

docs.title: Weights or Skills? A Survey of Robot-Learning Techniques: from Action-Predicting Weights to Robots that Write their Own Skills
docs.text:
• 作者：Gaytri Jena, Kapil Wanaskar, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha, Vasu Sharma 等 6 人
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.01851v1

Robot learning is splitting into two bets: policies that bake competence into frozen weights (vision-language-action, or VLA, models), and agents that write and refine their own executable skills as code. This survey organises the field around that axis of weights versus skills.

docs.title: Teleopit: A Full-Embodiment Humanoid Teleoperation System
docs.text:
• 作者：Bingqian Wu, Zicheng Xu, Xianghui Fan, Dayu Li, Xiangru Huang
  • 提交：2026-08-03 · 分类 cs.RO · arXiv:2608.01834v1

Humanoid teleoperation for demonstration collection requires coordinated whole-body motion, continuous dexterous hand control, and viewpoint control. Existing systems either simplify hand commands or depend on dedicated wearable sensors for fine-grained hand motion.

Digital pathology relies on high-resolution whole slide images for accurate diagnosis, yet limitations in imaging devices, storage, and transmission often make lower-resolution pathology images more common in clinical workflows.

Existing scaling strategies for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically expand either model parameters or sequential inference computation, incurring substantial memory or latency overhead.

docs.title: SocietyBench: Forecasting Counterfactual Social-World Evolution
docs.text:
• 作者：Zhenran Wang, Zhonghan Bian, Jinsong Li, Zhangyang Qi
  • 提交：2026-08-04 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.04009v1

Large language models (LLMs), and the agents built on top of them, are now benchmarked heavily on whether they can finish a task -- fix a bug, drive a browser, operate a GUI. A complementary social ability, namely how well a model understands and forecasts the way real social events unfold, has barely been measured.

docs.text:
• 作者：Zhenran Wang, Zhonghan Bian, Jinsong Li, Zhangyang Qi
  • 提交：2026-08-04 · 分类 cs.CL · arXiv:2608.04008v1

Benchmarks that measure the forecasting ability of large language models are almost always retrospective: the event has happened, the answer is somewhere on the Web, and the evaluation must defend itself against memorisation. We report the opposite design.
